paper.title_en: Search for <math altimg="si3.svg"><mrow><msup><mrow/><mn>4</mn></msup><mover><mrow><mtext>Li</mtext></mrow><mo stretchy="true">‾</mo></mover></mrow></math> from <math altimg="si6.svg"><mrow><mover><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">p</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="true">‾</mo></mover><mo linebreak="goodbreak">+</mo><msup><mrow/><mn>3</mn></msup><mover><mrow><mtext>He</mtext></mrow><mo stretchy="true">‾</mo></mover></mrow></math> femtoscopy in Pb-Pb collisions at <math altimg="si7.svg"><mrow><msqrt><msub><mi>s</mi><mtext>NN</mtext></msub></msqrt><mo linebreak="goodbreak">=</mo><mn>5.36</mn></mrow></math> TeV with ALICE
paper.abstract_en: In these proceedings, the search for <math altimg="si3.svg"><mrow><msup><mrow/><mn>4</mn></msup><mover><mrow><mtext>Li</mtext></mrow><mo stretchy="true">‾</mo></mover></mrow></math> in Pb-Pb collisions with ALICE is presented. The particle is reconstructed via its two-body decay channel <math altimg="si8.svg"><mrow><msup><mrow/><mn>4</mn></msup><mover><mrow><mtext>Li</mtext></mrow><mo stretchy="true">‾</mo></mover><mo>→</mo><mover><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">p</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="true">‾</mo></mover><mo linebreak="goodbreak">+</mo><msup><mrow/><mn>3</mn></msup><mover><mrow><mtext>He</mtext></mrow><mo stretchy="true">‾</mo></mover></mrow></math>, using femtoscopic correlations. A dedicated analysis procedure has been developed to subtract the correlated and uncorrelated <math altimg="si9.svg"><mrow><mover><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">p</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="true">‾</mo></mover><msup><mo>+</mo><mn>3</mn></msup><mover><mrow><mtext>He</mtext></mrow><mo stretchy="true">‾</mo></mover></mrow></math> combinatorial background. The production yield of <math altimg="si3.svg"><mrow><msup><mrow/><mn>4</mn></msup><mover><mrow><mtext>Li</mtext></mrow><mo stretchy="true">‾</mo></mover></mrow></math> is compared with that of <math altimg="si4.svg"><mrow><msup><mrow/><mn>4</mn></msup><mover><mrow><mtext>He</mtext></mrow><mo stretchy="true">‾</mo></mover></mrow></math>. Owing to the presence of several <sup loc="post">4</sup>Li resonances and their spin degeneracy, the production of <math altimg="si3.svg"><mrow><msup><mrow/><mn>4</mn></msup><mover><mrow><mtext>Li</mtext></mrow><mo stretchy="true">‾</mo></mover></mrow></math> is expected to be enhanced with respect to the compact <math altimg="si4.svg"><mrow><msup><mrow/><mn>4</mn></msup><mover><mrow><mtext>He</mtext></mrow><mo stretchy="true">‾</mo></mover></mrow></math>, making this new measurement a sensitive probe for testing nucleosynthesis models in high-energy hadronic collisions.
